description: Ask-a-question run against a knowledge graph, via an already-registered KnowledgeGraphSearchResource -- no vector-store settings required.

outputs.description: Reports entities_matched and neighbors as run metadata.

graph_resource_key.label: Graph Resource Key
graph_resource_key.description: Resource key of an already-registered KnowledgeGraphSearchResource (from a KnowledgeGraphSearchServerComponent in the same code location).

entity.label: Entity
entity.description: Static default entity name/search term. Can be left unset if every run supplies KnowledgeGraphSearchQueryRunConfig.entity instead.

entity_type.label: Entity Type
entity_type.description: Restrict search_entities to this entity type.

hops.label: Hops
hops.description: get_neighbors hop count (capped at 3 by the resource).

relation.label: Relation
relation.description: Restrict get_neighbors to edges with this relation name.

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags to apply to the asset.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
